nodes.title: The Studio gate is server/studio/qa/ (gate.js runGate): G0 AST static, G1 boot/errors/CSP/network, G2 seam, G3 words from the strings table, G4 layout + 44 px targets + label-to-referent anchoring, G5 scripted play against host truth, G6 per-archetype semantics (science direction), G7 state graph, G8 no-hint, G9 4x-CPU perf; a build passes only if EVERY check passes; truth and grading stay in Node (qa/graders.js, the one grader)

Every frame archetype is designed and gated at 360 x 320 units (the phone tray's aspect): nothing scrolls or sits outside the box, targets >= 52 units (44 CSS px at the tray's 0.86 scale; 66 for B1-B2), reachable and non-overlapping

build.js buildRace: race of taxila-gpt6 low + gpt-5.6-terra low (+ taxila-gpt6-luna low opportunistic, taxila-codex on 429), stream guard at token time, deterministic fixers, gate, <= 2 repairs from failing check ids with negative memory last; the winner's bytes are exactly the gated bytes; every call child-free on the background lane

stream-guard.js removes URLs, network/eval/storage APIs, embedding tags and unknown Studio.t keys at token time, committing only at tag/statement/rule/line ends, so guard(a)+guard(b) == guard(a+b) for every split

router.js decide() is pure and ordered: parent off/safety -> fallback; whiteboard -> script planner; no kit truth -> fallback; promoted library first; bond stage meeting / 'Only ready-made ones' -> promoted only; not live-buildable (P(pass by lead) < 0.95 at n >= 30, or picture truth needs human review) -> fallback; caps (3 live builds per lesson, $0.60 per child-day, $8 per month, global breaker) -> fallback; revealable() is the one never-un-gated predicate

Archetype library v1: 12 frame archetypes (shade_fraction, bar_chart_read, hub_flows, number_line_jump, balance_scale, sort_bins, sequence_steps, slider_law, process_chain, labelled_parts, pictograph, timeline) + the whiteboard; code picks the archetype and params from verified truth, the model writes only the strings table and craft line; labelled_parts is library-only (pictureTruth human_review)

The whiteboard archetype: plan.js planWhiteboard(ask) has taxila-gpt6-luna (effort none, background lane) write compact timed ops for her line (child name redacted), code expands/fits/separates them, qa/whiteboard.js gates W0 shape, W1 fits the stage, W2 no overlapping words, W3 labels anchored, W4 numbers from her line or the verified kit with correct arithmetic, W5 words hers or the book's, W6 timing, W7 labels only and no names, W8 picture counts; one repair inside a 7 s budget; a failing script is never drawn

The gate service studio-qa (infra/studio-qa, Playwright 1.63.0) runs as a Container App in the untrusted environment taxila-forge-untrusted (1 vCPU / 2 GiB, min 1), external ingress locked by a bearer token (taxila-web reports 401 shared outbound IPs, too many for an allow-list); the API reaches it via STUDIO_QA_URL, a local Chromium only under STUDIO_QA_LOCAL=1. Deployed 2026-10-04 (image wt-66d1a6f9d19b); taxila-web is NOT wired yet (--wire-web is the main loop's call)
server/studio/memory/<archetype>.json holds recurring failure SHAPES (never code), seeded from the probe's failing-check counts; placed in the build prompt and last in every repair prompt

A race in which every arm died on a network error before any gate ran returns reason builder_unreachable: it reveals nothing, does not feed the breaker's failure streak (it spent nothing), and the router bench skips and re-runs it instead of counting it as a failed build

The router bench counts P(pass by lead) against the fixed bench lead (routes.json defaults.leadMs, 90 s, the prefetch lead), never the archetype's own leadMs, which --write sets to 1.1 x the measured p90

Router bench (race, server code path, local gate, n = 30 per archetype, params/alt alternating): 10 archetypes 30/30 by the 90 s lead (80% Wilson 0.948-1) and marked live; balance_scale 25/30 [0.729-0.903] and labelled_parts 26/30 [0.768-0.927] (also human_review) library-only; time to playable p50 15-48 s, p90 23-61 s; $0.029-0.138 per passed build
Seeded-mutant suite (evals/live-studio/mutants.mjs, local gate): recall 51/51 over 3 probe kinds (>= 15 mutants each), false alarms 0/9 goldens (hand + 2 bench winners per kind)

Gate on Azure (studio-qa, tests/prod/w2f-studio-gate.mjs part A, US sandbox -> eastus2, sequential): 24/24 goldens pass at params and held-out params, 3/3 seeded mutants refused, unauthenticated call refused; p50 5689 ms, p90 8968 ms, n = 30 (bar p50 <= 12 s, p90 <= 18 s)

Whiteboard planner bench (30 production teacher lines, classes 4-7): taxila-gpt6-luna none 24/30 passed the board gate (14 first try, 24 after <= 1 repair), 1 nothing-to-draw, p50 3.0 s / p90 5.9 s, $0.00035 per line with the lane cap lifted; with today's lane cap 21/30 (4 lines lost to the background bucket's queue deadline); luna low 26/30 at p90 13.1 s; taxila-fast none 6/30

The stream guard's first www rule stripped the tail of http://www.w3.org/2000/svg, so every createElementNS build drew nothing (10 of 17 failed arms in the pilot); fixed with a lookbehind and a split-invariance test
Committing the guarded stream at a fixed hold-back let a cut hide a token from its rule (27 differing cuts in the property test); replaced by commits at tag/statement/rule/line ends
Building at the probe's 360 x 640 portrait viewport would scale builds to ~0.37 in the tray (44 px targets -> ~16 px); replaced by the 360 x 320 design box
taxila-fast effort none as the whiteboard planner: 6/30 lines passed the board gate vs 22-26/29 for taxila-gpt6-luna none at the same speed
Deciding label-over-another-part from bounding boxes failed correct labels (a group's box covers the flower centre); replaced by sampling points through every layer (elementsFromPoint)

A whiteboard gate without picture-count checks passed a pizza cut into 6 by diameters for '8 parts' and 2 boxes for '3 equal groups'; W8 added (equal-shape families must have her count, a round whole is never cut by lines)

Recording a race whose gate browser died as a failed build (5 balance_scale rows); a gate that cannot run is infrastructure: skipped and re-run in the bench, gate_unavailable (reveal nothing) in a lesson

The router bench counted races in which every arm hit a network error (a container restart at the end of the n = 30 run) as failed builds: 11 archetypes read 29/30 instead of 30/30, and in a lesson the same fault would have fed the breaker's failure streak; replaced by builder_unreachable

Counting P(pass by lead) against the archetype's own route leadMs: --write sets that to 1.1 x p90, so a re-run of the same rows re-counted against ~35 s instead of 90 s and would have flipped live archetypes to library-only with no new data; replaced by the fixed bench lead
